title: CeDiRNet-STEM
description: Optional nanoparticle center/radius detection and multiclass semantic segmentation of paired BF/HAADF STEM images.

manifest.title: Dataset manifest
manifest.description: Toolbox version-4 export: images [BF, HAADF], points [x, y, radius] or [x, y, radius_x, radius_y] for nanoparticles, semantic_mask and per-item semantic_classes for segmentation. Export from the model annotation project; no manual manifest required.

nanoparticles.title: Enable nanoparticles
nanoparticles.description: Independently enable particle center/radius detection. At least one task must be true.

segmentation.title: Enable multiclass segmentation
segmentation.description: Requires a class-ID mask for training and trained semantic weights for inference.

semantic_classes.title: Semantic classes (JSON)
semantic_classes.description: Ordered names; index is mask class ID. Class 0 is a real class, not implicitly background. 255 is ignored.

model.title: Weights
model.description: Optional training initialization. Inference requires trained weights for each enabled task. Legacy stock particle checkpoint is supported only for particle-only mode.

localisation.title: Localisation weights
localisation.description: Particle-only dependency; ignored when nanoparticles is false.

display_interval.title: Validation / visualization interval
display_interval.description: Run deterministic training/validation diagnostics every N epochs and at the final epoch.
